newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Air disaster follows murdered bishop's funeral.
newsitem.headline: Air disaster follows murdered bishop's funeral.

text.p: A Philippine Roman Catholic bishop died in an air crash on Friday after attending the funeral of a murdered fellow bishop, police said.
Bishop Antonino Nepomuceno and three others were killed when their light plane struck a tree after takeoff from Jolo airport in the southern Philippines and crashed.
Church officials said Nepomuceno, 72, was rushing to another appointment after the funeral and had hitched a ride on the plane bound for nearby Zamboanga city.
Thousands of weeping Christians and Moslems had gathered for the funeral of murdered bishop Benjamin de Jesus in Jolo, 900 km (590 miles) south of Manila.
De Jesus was shot dead in front of his cathedral on February 4 in the latest outbreak of violence in a southern region torn for decades by feuds between Moslems and Christians.
The Moslem extremist Abu Sayyaf group, which is fighting for an Islamic state, has denied involvement in the murder.
